segments.text: The law Marcus, this is Sarah Flamell benline, how can I help?
Hi Sarah, we need 2500 STM32 Controllers for the New Ward.
The production run starts in three weeks, so deliver it is critical.
Understood, I will check the supplier and send you a date by Thursday.
Price is less important this time, but please do not be late again.
I will also look for an alternate part in case Stark is short.
Perfect, you can reach me on my mobile, 06601234.
